strings.jp: 「{sub:A0}さん! 地面から{n} ふきだす炎に 気をつけて!」{n}
strings.en: "Momotaro! Watch out for the flames shooting up from the ground!"{n}

strings.jp: 「大変です {sub:A0}さん!」{n}{n}{n}「酒香童子 羅生門さまと 並ぶ{n} 軍神・三千世界さまが ついに{n} 動かれたとの 知らせが!」{n}「はるか昔 戦うことを やめたはずの{n} あのお方が なぜ 今になって?」{n}
strings.en: "This is terrible, Momotaro!"{n}{n}{n}"Word has come that the war god Sanzen Sekai, equal to Shuko Doji and Rashomon, has finally made his move!"{n}"He gave up fighting long, long ago... so why now, of all times?"{n}

strings.jp: {sub:C2} {sub:A0}か! 羅生門だ!」{n}{n}{n}「はっはっはっは!{n} さすが 伐折羅王さまの{n} ちょくぞくの軍だ! てごわい!」{n}「{sub:A0}! ここは{n} わしに まかせて 先を いぞげ!」{n}
strings.en: "Oh! Momotaro, is it? It's Rashomon!"{n}{n}{n}"Ha ha ha ha!{n} As expected of King Basara's own army! They're tough!"{n}"Momotaro! Leave this place to me and hurry on ahead!"{n}
